content.text: Let’s celebrate Earth Day by exploring nature and learning fun facts about animals! Kids will also discover why conserving nature is so important and how we can all help protect our planet. A playful and meaningful way to learn and grow! #EarthDay #ConserveNature #KidsLearning #NatureForKids #AnimalFacts #EarthDayShorts #SaveThePlanet #KidsShorts #CuteAnimals #LearnWithFun Hi....We are Peach, Peanut and Poppy and we are so happy to meet you here. A very warm welcome to our channel! We regularly upload loads of fun, interactive and educative videos for Toddlers, Preschoolers, Kindergarteners & Primary Schoolers. So don't forget to check out our videos to Learn the Fun way!
